list: Official 55-trophy list: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze

exophase.name: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list
exophase.covers: Official trophy names, descriptions and grades

psnprofiles.name: PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies
psnprofiles.covers: Grades and the progress counts PSN tracks

atlas.name: Atlas note — built from the official description
atlas.covers: Our own advice drawn only from what the official description states; not yet verified in-game

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum lands the moment the other 54 trophies are yours. There is no extra task behind it, so treat this page as the plan: work the roadmap in order, clear the missable trophies on your first run through each moment, and let the collectibles build up as you explore Leonida.
steps: Follow the Platinum Roadmap view in order, stage by stage.
Earn every missable trophy the first time its moment comes up.
Sweep collectibles and activities between story chapters so nothing is left to grind at the end.
Check the progress bar here: at 54 of 54, this trophy pops.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: This is the opening mission, Gone Fishing, and it unlocks through story play alone. Play the introduction at your own pace, follow the on-screen prompts, and the trophy pops when the mission ends. Nothing here can be missed.
steps: Start a new game and play the opening sequence.
Follow the prompts through Gone Fishing to its end card.
If you skipped past it, replay the mission from the pause menu.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1 and the chapter-complete trophy is yours. Chapters in GTA 6 run as a chain of story missions, so keep taking the next mission marker until the chapter closes. Story trophies like this one cannot be missed: unfinished missions can be replayed.
steps: Play through the Chapter 1 mission chain in order.
Clear any side objective the mission asks for before moving on.
The trophy pops on the chapter's closing scene.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2 by finishing its story missions in order. This is pure story progress: there is no side task hiding inside the requirement, and no way to lock yourself out of it. Push the main mission markers forward and the trophy follows.
steps: Work the Chapter 2 mission chain from its first marker to its last.
Use spare time between missions for collectibles, not instead of the story.
The trophy pops when Chapter 2 closes.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Chapter 3 closes the same way the earlier chapters did: finish its missions and the trophy pops. By this point in the game you will have most of the map open, so it is a good moment to bank a few activity trophies between story beats.
steps: Play the Chapter 3 missions in order until the chapter ends.
Between missions, try one new activity type toward Master of None.
The trophy pops on the chapter's closing scene.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4 to earn this one. It is the last chapter trophy before the finale, so before you push into the final missions, check the Missable view: any one-shot trophy you have not earned yet is easier to set up now than after the story ends.
steps: Complete the Chapter 4 mission chain.
Before the finale, clear any open missable trophies.
The trophy pops when Chapter 4 closes.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: The gold for finishing the story. The final mission is the point of no return, so this is flagged missable in the sense that you should finish your open one-shot trophies before you start it: once the credits roll, some set-ups are harder to arrange. Play the finale, watch it through, and the gold pops.
steps: Clear the missable trophies in the Missable view first.
Start the final mission from its marker and play it to the end.
The gold trophy pops on completion.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Breakfast Run is a named story mission, and this trophy is its completion mark. Take the mission when it appears, play it through, and the trophy pops at the end. Like other mission trophies it can be replayed if you ever need to.
steps: Pick up the Breakfast Run mission marker.
Play the mission through to its end card.
Replay it from the pause menu if it did not register.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: The Cartel Heist is one of the game's big set-piece missions. The trophy asks only that you complete it, so focus on the mission objectives and the escape rather than on style. Stock up on armour and ammo before you start, and keep a getaway vehicle in mind.
steps: Start The Cartel Heist when its marker appears.
Follow the mission objectives through the heist and the escape.
The trophy pops when the mission completes.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Child's Play is a named story mission. Play it through from its marker and the trophy pops at the end. There is no extra condition, so treat it as a story checkpoint on the road to the platinum.
steps: Take the Child's Play mission marker.
Complete the mission objectives.
The trophy pops on the end card.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Headliners is a named story mission and this trophy marks finishing it. Play the mission as it comes in the story order. If you are hunting efficiently, use the wait between story missions for nearby collectibles rather than fast-travelling past them.
steps: Start the Headliners mission from its marker.
Play it through to completion.
The trophy pops at the mission end.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: VCIA Takedown is a named story mission set around the airport, and the trophy is its completion mark. Bring a fast car and expect a chase: the mission's shape is in its name. Finish it and the trophy pops.
steps: Pick up the VCIA Takedown mission marker.
Play the mission through, keeping a fast vehicle handy.
The trophy pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Operation Savage Glory is a named story mission, and finishing it earns this trophy. Its military-style name suggests a heavy firefight, so go in with full armour, a good rifle, and snacks or healing items if the game provides them. Complete the mission and the trophy pops.
steps: Start Operation Savage Glory from its marker.
Stock armour and ammo before the first firefight.
Finish the mission to pop the trophy.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The second gold, and the real endgame: reach 100% completion. That means the story, the stranger strands, the collectibles, the activities and the miscellaneous tasks the in-game stats page counts. Open the pause-menu stats regularly and clear the lowest categories first; the checklist here tracks the trophies, the stats page tracks the percentage.
steps: Finish the story and all stranger mission strands.
Clear every collectible set and activity the stats page lists.
Watch the in-game completion percentage and mop up the last categories.
At 100%, the gold pops.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts across Leonida. Stunts are the jumps, near-misses, airtime and slides the game counts as you drive and ride, so this one builds itself during normal play if you drive boldly. For a deliberate grind, chain jumps off ramps and highway crests in a fast car and watch the stunt counter climb.
steps: Drive fast and take jumps, ramps and crests whenever you see them.
Chain near-misses in traffic for extra stunt credit.
Keep a stunt-friendly car handy; the counter carries across sessions.
At 250 stunts, the silver pops.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample each of the game's 9 activity types once. The activities include the shooting range, drone races, fishing, arcade games, bowling, meditation, hunting and racing, plus one more the in-game activities menu lists. Open that menu, work down it, and tick each type off once.
steps: Open the in-game activities menu to see all 9 types.
Try each type once, even briefly.
Check the tracker here: 9 of 9 types tried pops the trophy.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold all 42 Shooting Range challenges. This is the hardest silver in the set, so treat it as a skill grind: learn each challenge's target pattern, use the weapon the challenge gives you, and replay the ones you silver until they turn gold. Short, calm bursts beat spray-and-pray, and the range lets you retry instantly.
steps: Find a Shooting Range and open its challenge list.
Work through the 42 challenges, noting which need gold.
Replay silver-medal challenges with slower, aimed bursts.
When all 42 show gold, the silver pops.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Each location is its own course, so learn the gates on a practice run before you race to win: cut corners only where the gates allow it, and use boost on the long straights. The map marks each race spot, so work through them region by region.
steps: Open the map and mark the nearest Top Fun drone race.
Fly a practice lap to learn the gates, then race to win.
Move to the next location; 14 wins pops the trophy.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Different is the key word: the same race won twice counts once, so keep moving to new race markers around Leonida. Mix street, off-road and water races if the game offers them, and upgrade or pick a vehicle that suits each course.
steps: Open the map and pick a race you have not won yet.
Win it, then move to a fresh race marker.
Keep a list here: 20 different wins pops the trophy.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges are head-to-head: land more or bigger fish than Cal within the time limit. Watch the tension meter so your line does not snap, reel steadily when the fish runs, and use the best rod and bait you can buy first.
steps: Find Cal's fishing challenge and accept it.
Buy the best rod and bait available before you start.
Keep tension in the safe zone and reel when the fish tires.
Out-fish Cal to pop the trophy.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game. Arcades sit in bars and entertainment spots around Leonida: walk up to a cabinet, start a game, and play it to its end rather than quitting mid-way. Pick the shortest cabinet you find if you only want the trophy quickly.
steps: Find an arcade cabinet in a bar or arcade spot.
Start a game and play it through to its end.
Completing one game pops the trophy.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's mission strand by completing his final mission. Character strands unlock as the story moves, so keep taking Andy's missions whenever his marker appears. The trophy pops on his last mission's end card.
steps: Take Andy's missions as they appear.
Play his strand through to its final mission.
Complete it to pop the trophy.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's mission strand with his final mission. Kenton's strand leans on the water, so expect boats in his missions and keep a fast boat or a waterfront approach in mind. Complete his last mission and the trophy pops.
steps: Play Kenton's missions as his marker appears.
Keep a boat handy for his water-based jobs.
Finish his final mission to pop the trophy.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's mission strand with his final mission. Billy's jobs suit a bike, so keep a good motorcycle ready and expect fast, solo riding. Play his strand to its end and the trophy pops.
steps: Take Billy's missions when his marker appears.
Keep a fast bike ready for his jobs.
Complete his final mission to pop the trophy.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Strangers appear as question-mark markers on the map: meet them, take their jobs, and see each strand through to its end. Eight completed strands earns the silver, so keep an eye out for new markers as new regions open.
steps: Watch the map for stranger markers as you explore.
Take each stranger's missions and finish the whole strand.
Complete 8 strands to pop the silver.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's mission strand with his final mission. Randy's jobs are about moving product, so expect supply runs and deliveries under pressure. Play his strand through and the trophy pops on his last mission.
steps: Take Randy's missions as they appear.
Play his strand through to its final mission.
Complete it to pop the trophy.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's mission strand with his final mission. Tyrone's strand is the last of the named character strands on this list, so by the time you reach it you will be well into the map. Play his missions through and the trophy pops.
steps: Take Tyrone's missions as they appear.
Play his strand through to its final mission.
Complete it to pop the trophy.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. Meditation spots are quiet scenic points, usually on hills, beaches and lookouts. The in-game map or a collectible checklist marks them once discovered, so sweep region by region and sit at each one until the meditation completes.
steps: Explore Leonida and note meditation spots as you find them.
Visit each spot and complete the meditation prompt.
Cover all 18 spots; the last one pops the trophy.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunt is a tracking job: follow the trail, watch for tracks and signs, and take the shot cleanly when the unique animal shows itself. Bring a scoped rifle and approach quietly from downwind so you do not spook it.
steps: Take Bret's hunting job when it appears.
Follow the tracks and signs to the unique animal.
Take a clean shot with a scoped rifle to pop the trophy.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 full collectible card sets. Cards hide across Leonida in shops, houses and odd corners, and each set needs every card in it. Pick up every card you pass, check your collection menu to see which sets are closest, and finish the three nearest sets first.
steps: Grab every collectible card you see while exploring.
Check the collection menu to see which sets are nearest complete.
Finish 3 full sets to pop the silver.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK It feature at 100 locations. WAiNK It is the in-game photo or tagging action at marked spots, so the grind is a tour of Leonida: visit each marked location, trigger WAiNK It, and move on. Work region by region so you do not revisit the same spots twice.
steps: Find a WAiNK It spot and trigger the action.
Sweep each region's marked spots in order.
At 100 locations, the silver pops.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges are the small goals the game tracks across driving, combat, exploration and activities, and they stack up naturally as you play. Check the challenges menu, clear the easy ones first for momentum, and the count carries across the whole playthrough.
steps: Open the challenges menu and note the easiest ones.
Clear short challenges between story missions.
At 50 completed, the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then escape. Set this up deliberately: bring your partner along, raise heat to 4 stars in a quiet area, then break line of sight and hide until the stars clear. Do not let your partner get arrested or go down mid-escape, or the attempt fails.
steps: Bring your partner and raise your wanted level to 4 stars.
Break line of sight: alleys, tunnels and water all help.
Stay hidden until all 4 stars clear with your partner beside you.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. The trick is the opposite of a normal robbery: keep the heat you already have and do not let it drop between shops. Pick three small shops close together, rob each quickly, and drive straight to the next while the stars stay up.
steps: Bring your partner and pick 3 small shops close together.
Rob the first shop and keep your wanted level.
Hit the second and third without the stars clearing.
Three in a row pops the trophy.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Every new car, bike, boat or aircraft you get into counts the first time, so variety is the whole strategy: drive something different every time you travel, visit car parks, docks and airfields, and the counter climbs on its own.
steps: Get into a vehicle you have never driven before.
Vary your rides: cars, bikes, boats and aircraft all count.
Visit car parks, docks and airfields for new models.
At 100 discovered, the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Set it up where enemies bunch together: trigger Combat Focus only when five or more are in view, and drop them fast before the meter runs out. A mission with a crowded firefight is the best stage, and a retry costs nothing if the first attempt falls short.
steps: Find a firefight with 5 or more enemies close together.
Trigger Combat Focus only when they are all in view.
Drop all 5 before the focus ends.
Five in one use pops the trophy.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure from Vice City International Airport. In plain terms: get a plane off the ground without filing a flight plan, or steal one and take off. Bring a fast approach to the runway, grab a plane, and get airborne before security closes in.
steps: Head to VCIA with a fast vehicle.
Get to a plane on the runway or apron.
Take off without a scheduled departure to pop the trophy.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Get into a Rhino tank and feel the heat. Rhinos appear once your wanted level climbs high or at military spots, so raise heat in the open and look for the tank rolling in, then climb aboard. The trophy is about the ride, so take it for a spin once you are inside.
steps: Raise your wanted level to draw a Rhino, or find one at a military spot.
Climb into the Rhino tank.
Drive it around to pop the trophy.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. This is a stealth job, not a smash-and-grab: go in quiet, avoid the cameras and the staff's line of sight, take the goods and leave before any alarm. If you are spotted, leave and reset the attempt rather than fighting through it.
steps: Pick a jewelry store and scout its cameras and staff.
Enter quietly and stay out of sight lines.
Take the goods and leave before any alarm.
Undetected to the exit pops the trophy.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time. Bank vaults are the big robberies: plan the approach, bring your partner if the job allows it, and have a getaway car parked close with a clear route out. Each vault counts only if you escape clean, so do not linger for extra loot.
steps: Find a bank vault robbery and plan a getaway route first.
Rob the vault and escape without being caught.
Repeat at 4 more vaults.
Five clean escapes pops the silver.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks run set routes around the city: block one, crack it open, grab the cash and get clear before the response arrives. A sticky bomb or a hard ram stops the truck; speed matters more than firepower once the doors are open.
steps: Find an armored truck on its route.
Stop it and crack the rear doors.
Grab the cash and escape before backup arrives.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. The map fills in as you travel, so this trophy rewards the tour: drive, fly and sail into every corner, including the small towns and the swamps beyond the city. The map's fog or area counter shows what is left, so finish the blank patches last.
steps: Travel through every region: city, coast, swamps and small towns.
Check the map for unexplored patches.
Enter the last blank areas to pop the trophy.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Illegal operations are marked gang hideouts and stash spots: hit one per gang, not nine in one territory. The map and gang intel show which gang holds which spot, so work through the list gang by gang.
steps: Find an illegal operation and note which gang holds it.
Rob it and escape.
Repeat for the other 8 gangs.
One hit per gang pops the trophy.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to a beach bar on Ocean Drive, order a cocktail, and take it in with the ocean in front of you. It is a breather trophy: no combat, no timer, just the view.
steps: Go to Ocean Beach and find a beach bar.
Order a cocktail.
Enjoy it with the ocean view to pop the trophy.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car through the showroom glass and out the front: pick a showroom with a clear run-up, build speed on the approach, and aim for the glass. One clean smash-and-exit is all it takes, so set it up rather than improvising mid-chase.
steps: Pick a vehicle showroom with a clear approach.
Build speed and drive through the glass.
Exit the showroom in the same run to pop the trophy.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. Find the alley, pick up a ball, and bowl a proper frame: the trophy is about playing the game through, not about the score. Bring your partner along if the alley allows it and enjoy the break.
steps: Find the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
Start a game and bowl your frames.
Follow through to the end of the game to pop the trophy.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Build a partnership with mass appeal. This one is about your duo's standing: play together, pull off jobs as a pair, and raise your joint reputation until the game recognises the partnership. Keep doing co-op moments with your partner and it pops in time.
steps: Play jobs and activities together with your partner.
Raise your partnership standing through shared successes.
The trophy pops when the partnership hits mass appeal.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make 500 choices across the game. Choices are the small decisions the game tracks: dialogue picks, approach choices, and the yes-or-no moments in missions and the open world. PSN tracks the count toward 500, so keep choosing rather than skipping: every decision nudges the counter, and the trophy pops at 500.
steps: Pick dialogue and approach options instead of skipping them.
Take the choice moments in missions and the open world.
Watch the PSN count climb toward 500.
At 500 choices, the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Succeed on your second try. The name says it all: fail something once, then nail it on the immediate retry. The cleanest way is a short activity you can attempt twice in a row, such as a race or a challenge: miss the first attempt, then win the second and the trophy pops.
steps: Pick a short repeatable activity, like a race.
Fail or lose the first attempt.
Win the immediate second attempt to pop the trophy.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness something strange. Leonida hides odd events: strange lights, odd encounters and easter eggs tucked away from the main roads. Explore the quiet corners at night, follow anything unusual you see, and the trophy pops when you stumble on one of the game's weird moments.
steps: Explore Leonida's quiet corners, especially at night.
Follow anything strange you notice.
Witnessing one odd event pops the trophy.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone over with a melee drive-by. That means striking a person with a melee weapon from a moving vehicle, bowling-pin style. Find a slow, open stretch with pedestrians, line up the pass at moderate speed, and swing as you pass. One clean knockdown pops it.
steps: Get a vehicle and a melee weapon.
Find an open stretch with pedestrians.
Strike someone with the melee weapon from the moving vehicle.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists; your contacts clean them for a cut. Keep laundering after every big job rather than sitting on dirty cash, and the total climbs toward $250,000 across the playthrough.
steps: Earn Marked Bills from robberies and heists.
Launder them through your contacts after each job.
Repeat until $250,000 is cleaned to pop the trophy.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Clothes, weapons, ammo, food and vehicle upgrades all count, so this one builds itself if you gear up properly through the story. If you are close near the end, a big weapon or wardrobe shop clears the gap in one visit.
steps: Buy weapons, ammo, clothes and upgrades as you play.
Spend across different shop types.
At $100,000 total spent, the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties. Garages go on sale as you progress and earn money, and each one stores your vehicles. Check the property listings or in-game real-estate app regularly, buy each garage as it appears, and the trophy pops on the eighth.
steps: Check property listings for garages for sale.
Buy each garage as it becomes available.
Owning all 8 pops the trophy.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app lets you register vehicles you own or find, so use a mix of cars and bikes you come across. Open the app, register a vehicle, and repeat until 10 are on the books.
steps: Open the Scooter Bros app on the in-game phone.
Register a vehicle you own or have found.
Register 10 different vehicles to pop the trophy.
